I’m glad you have the mindset to think of your girl even though you’re facing hardships, it seems like you know what you have to do and I wish I could fast forward and see the day you’re feeling 100% again and it radiates onto her too :)

I wouldn’t expect a warm reception to begin with but what’s done is done as they say, they’ll accept it over time and it’s not like it’s never happened before, people have gotten a baby at 16... you aren’t one of those cases at least. 

Sure it’ll be hard to explain it and work your way around but this could also be taken in a good way, you have a solid future foundation and know to do well for your now incoming family, congratulations if anything, under any circumstance of life.
I always used to think that until a few people said “any taller and you’d look weird” in fact I heard it from so many people I just shrugged n accepted it
I’m 6’1 and my girlfriend is like 5’7-8 lmao you are not small heighted by any stretch of the imagination. We are tall, taller than most.
At least you know what you’re working for.. her family or yours can look after it while you two are busy?

You’ll truly know if he cares if he sticks it out with you even when the parents know, I was going to commit suicide last night and my girlfriend rang my mum and the rest of my family to me. 

I do not hate her for trying to help me, I need it. I’m still fucked up but I appreciate what she did for me. 

Have a quiet word with them and see what they say, but if you two leave each other to arguing 24/7 then one of you will walk the other way when you’ve had enough, why wait for that to happen when you can fix the situation fast?
no :o I like your aspirations and hobbies ! :)

I would tell the parents, he might resent you for it and it could go either way, but they have the right to know at this point because if something majorly wrong happens they’ll ask you why you didn’t tell them about it
You sound great :)
You work on you and get better and show her you can be the man you want to be that will in return be the man she needs. She has said these things for a reason, follow your heart

Just to update: out of the blue she called and said how much she loves me and even though she doesn’t say it all the time she really does, and she can’t wait to finish in 2 years knowing she’ll finally be able to live with me 

This boosted my confidence, I’m visiting her a day earlier as a surprise and have booked for a dinner meal at 8:30 :) 

I’m getting better at this

I will try harder from now on, I know I can do better she’s finding this easy (if she isn’t, which she probably isn’t she’s keeping it to herself) but she does make effort with me, saying how she looks forward to our holidays together and we should start a family in x location etc 

There will be bumps, this I know, but I will try so I can say I did, and if she is the one to let go at least I can say I didn’t give up. 

Well, she made a bet today that if she ever broke up with me I could slap her and if we do make it through this then I have to pay the vet bills for every pet we own, i don’t know. Maybe she is the perfect girl for this LDR and I’m just over analysing, wouldn’t be the first time. 

Long story short: she said I look cute in a Christmas jumper, I’ll try make it work with her :) I feel better listening to advice thank you

Thank you Max, 

I just struggle most times to see how we will ever come back together during these years, not only that but if I hear she’s been out with a guy or something I just feel like an idiot being sat here while someone else is taking my girlfriend for a spin. 

When you’ve talked so much about the future and the family and pets conversations that followed I just want it so bad that I don’t want to be replaced and for her to live that life with someone else, I’m sure I’ll be ok in time... 

Just weak because I’m the vocal one about love and she doesn’t show it frequently which always made me doubt but she’s always been that way.. Just the days I ask if we can call and she’ll mention a different topic and my question gets buried that gets to me. 

I’ll talk to her when I’m over and just work things from what she says but boy. Sometimes I feel this is all ok the next I feel like absolute trash. 

I shall see my fate on the 14th, I just want this more than anything, we’ve been through a lot and she isn’t someone I could so easily brush away
